displayTitle: Where's the Wookiee? the Search Continues...
synopsis: Re-join the hunt for the galaxy's most-wanted Wookiee in this third book in the popular Where's the Wookiee search-and-find series.Chewbacca is the Millennium Falcon's furry copilot--but what else do you know about the beloved Wookiee? Follow Chewie's journey throughout the Star Wars saga in ten detailed illustrated search-and-find scenes...from Kashyyyk to Ahch-To.
title: Where's the Wookiee? the Search Continues...
